body:
## What this adds

Two related additions to the IEC 60909 zero-sequence / single-phase (`fault="1ph"`) short-circuit model, motivated by earth-fault studies on systems earthed through a neutral earthing resistor (NER) and/or a zigzag earthing transformer:

**1. Neutral earthing impedance for ordinary transformers (`rn_ohm`).**
`xn_ohm` already exists but is only applied to power-station-unit transformers, and only as a reactance. This PR adds `rn_ohm` (resistive part) to `create_transformer` / `create_transformer_from_parameters` (and the bulk variants) and applies the neutral earthing impedance `3·(rn_ohm + j·xn_ohm)` to the zero-sequence impedance of **all** earthed-star vector groups (`dyn`, `ynd`, `yyn`, `ynyn`, `yny`, `yzn`), referred via the earthed-winding bus voltage and applied after the IEC transformer correction factor (the NER is not part of the transformer impedance). This lets a neutral earthing resistor limit the single-phase earth-fault current, as it physically does.

**2. Zigzag earthing transformer vector groups (`ZNyn`, `ZNd`, `ZNy`, `ZN`).**
Currently the zero-sequence model raises for Z-connected transformers. Per the YNzn zero-sequence model, the zigzag winding completely decouples the primary and secondary zero sequences and presents a low-impedance shunt-to-ground at its terminal: the HV-winding leakage portion (`si0_hv_partial`) in series with `3·Z_N` at the star point. An earthed-wye secondary (`ZNyn`) gets its own decoupled zero-sequence path (LV leakage portion + zero-sequence magnetising); a delta / unearthed secondary (`ZNd` / `ZNy`) has none. This enables single-phase earth-fault studies on delta-fed networks earthed via a zigzag transformer (common for MV solar/BESS collector systems).

## Tests

Added to `pandapower/test/shortcircuit/test_1ph.py` (parametrized over both solver paths):
- `test_trafo_neutral_earthing_impedance` — asserts the neutral earthing impedance adds exactly `3·Z_N` to the zero-sequence Thévenin impedance and leaves the positive sequence unchanged.
- `test_zigzag_earthing_transformer` — asserts a zigzag earths a delta-fed system, the NER limits the earth fault, and the primary/secondary zero sequences decouple (earthed-wye secondary has an LV path; delta secondary does not).

All existing `test_1ph` / `test_iec60909_4` tests still pass (the existing power-station-unit `xn_ohm` behaviour is unchanged — `rn_ohm` defaults to `nan`).

## Validation

Cross-checked on a real 132/33/0.8 kV solar collector network against DIgSILENT PowerFactory and textbook hand calculations: 3-phase agrees to ~0.5%, and the single-phase earth fault is reproduced (132 kV from the grid zero-sequence, the 33 kV NER-limited fault, and the inverter-LV) within modelling tolerance. The zigzag model follows the same zero-sequence equivalent circuit as the PowerFactory 2-winding transformer technical reference and the J&P Transformer Book.

## Note

CHANGELOG updated. Happy to adjust naming/placement to match maintainer preferences — and to sign the CLA if required.
